messages:
Alex (AE): Deal-desk ping: Saffron Ventures wants a 12mo Dedicated commit. List = $600,000/yr. They're asking 45% off for year 1 (conversion option to 36mo at renewal), net90, and a free 4-week implementation credit. They say investor-backed and will be a strategic reference. Need quick read.

Nora (Finance): 45% is very high. What's the requested net and do we have investor PO or payment security? Net90 on a startup is risky.

Alex (AE): Requested net = $330,000/yr. They offered a founder-signed PO and a note that lead investor will provide a non-binding support letter. No prepaid amount proposed.

Sam (Sales Ops): Quick math: list 600k -> 45% off = 330k; 30% off = 420k. Recommend we never do net90 without escrow or 50% prepay. Also, pilot/implementation credits should be capped and scoped.

Riley (Legal): Legal: net90 requires verified signatory and explicit late fee language. We'll need IP & SSO scoping excluded from discounts. Implementation credit okay if capped and timeboxed. Redline turnaround ~48 hours.

collections-bot: Please attach credit check or investor PO before approving net90. Net90 requires Collections sign-off.

Nora (Finance): For Marin: propose approving up to 30% discount conditional on: (1) 40% upfront prepaid, (2) signed PO with verified signatory, (3) legal redlines accepted, (4) Collections approves net terms. Anything >30% must go to CFO + exec committee.

Alex (AE): Customer pushing hard on 45% and will only consider 40% if we accept net90. I can try to get a 40% prepay or an investor guarantee.

Marin (CFO): I will NOT approve 45% or net90 without strong credit security. I can approve up to 30% max with 40% upfront (non-refundable) and Collections + Legal sign-off. For 31-40% I require: 50% prepaid OR corporate guarantee from investor + Legal & CTO (SRE) sign-offs. >40% requires exec committee memo and VP Sales justification. Document everything in the deal ticket.

Sam (Sales Ops): Adding renewal guardrail: conversion rate on renewal must default to list unless a renewal discount is explicitly approved by Finance. Also block stacking of implementation credits.

Alex (AE): I'll push for 40% prepay or investor guarantee and ask them to shorten payment terms to net30. Will update ticket once I have PO or payment confirmation.

Nora (Finance): Marking as "needs CFO sign-off" if they insist >30%. Tag me when PO/credit check attached.

Marin (CFO): Thanks team.
